taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-06, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 857.1 | 0.64 | 0.64
2 | 996.7 | 0.52 | 1.16
3 | 83.1 | 1.53 | 2.69
4 | 335.1 | 3.03 | 5.72
5 | 27.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-06, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-06 (Survey Area T)**

Station T-06 exhibits a 5-layer geoelectric succession:
- **Layer 1:** 857.1 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 0.64 m (base at 0.64 m)
- **Layer 2:** 996.7 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 0.52 m (base at 1.16 m)
- **Layer 3:** 83.1 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 1.53 m (base at 2.69 m)
- **Layer 4:** 335.1 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 3.03 m (base at 5.72 m)
- **Layer 5:** 27.9 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (underlying unit)

**Curve Classification:**
- Layers 1–3 ($r_1 < r_2 > r_3$): K-type
- Layers 2–4 ($r_2 > r_3 < r_4$): H-type
- Layers 3–5 ($r_3 < r_4 > r_5$): K-type

The resulting VES curve type is **KHK**. The existing classification on file as A-type is incorrect and does not reflect the layer resistivity sequence.

{"curve_type_stated": "KHK", "label_issue_flagged": true}
